config.gate: At256, in each embryo: matched3 >= all four controls and matched7 > all four controls. 512 diagnostic only. All six designs reported. Further full-graph confirmation required.
config.refine: One-to-one snap to dense maxima <=3um; preserve count and uniqueness; revert collisions.
config.consensus: Robust per-volume normalization (median and P90-P10, clip [-5,5]); logits + log1p(static votes), or logits + mean(log1p(static),log1p(temporal)) normalized separately.
config.novelty: Keep first 75% dense, append static maxima >3um from accepted centers, dense refill if needed.

result.scope: Six prespecified designs, repeated sparse development. No leaderboard or full graph claim.
